SEA_GLASS.SPIREENIGMAS-THE_SAVANT.title: Ambition Glass
SPIREENIGMAS-ASTRONOMICAL_CLOCK.title: Astronomical Clock
SPIREENIGMAS-ASTRONOMICAL_CLOCK.descript: #At the start of turn [blue]2[/blue], gain [E?] and draw [blue]!C![/blue] card(s).
SPIREENIGMAS-ASTRONOMICAL_CLOCK.flavor: Once remarkably precise, the clock's motions are now erratic and confused.
SPIREENIGMAS-CLOCKWORK_UNIVERSE.title: Clockwork Universe
SPIREENIGMAS-CLOCKWORK_UNIVERSE.descript: #Take an additional turn after your first turn each combat.
SPIREENIGMAS-CLOCKWORK_UNIVERSE.flavor: Disregarded as useless by the Spire denizens, you know this is something much greater.
SPIREENIGMAS-LIFEBLOOD.title: Lifeblood
SPIREENIGMAS-LIFEBLOOD.flavor: The warmth of the fire is enough to kindle your spirits anew.
SPIREENIGMAS-KINDERHART.title: Kinderhart
SPIREENIGMAS-KINDERHART.description: #Whenever you enter a *Rest* *Site*, perform a free *Rest*.
SPIREENIGMAS-KINDERHART.flavor: An object of myth from a time dedicated to recreating the Founder's burning blood.
SPIREENIGMAS-FUNCTIONAL_CORE.title: Functional Core
SPIREENIGMAS-FUNCTIONAL_CORE.description: #At the start of each combat, *Chirp* gains [E?].
SPIREENIGMAS-FUNCTIONAL_CORE.flavor: The device that sets you apart from your peers. A successful repair like this has never been recreated.
SPIREENIGMAS-PERFECTED_CORE.title: Perfected Core
SPIREENIGMAS-PERFECTED_CORE.description: #At the start of each combat, *Chirp* gains [E?].
SPIREENIGMAS-PERFECTED_CORE.flavor: Your first mention of this idea saw you banished from the Spire you called home. Now realized, there's no one who can keep you away.
SPIREENIGMAS-IMBUED_CANDLE.title: Imbued Candle
SPIREENIGMAS-IMBUED_CANDLE.flavor: A common ritual for practitioners, an imbued candle won't burn out for as long as it's owner lives.
SPIREENIGMAS-FEEDBACK_LOOP.title: Feedback Loop
SPIREENIGMAS-FEEDBACK_LOOP.description: #The first time *Chirp* attacks each turn, it gains [E?].
SPIREENIGMAS-FEEDBACK_LOOP.flavor: According to your calculations, this subroutine spends negative power. You've elected not to worry about it.
